notes_body: lick_recovery_primary_full.png = every first post-cue lick (WFIELD_BAL_FULL=1, 51,252 licks vs 16,076 capped); columns cued first lick -> far-contra aim, cued first lick -> cued lick angle, ITI first lick after quiet -> ITI angle. Balance = angle-matched GAIN RATIO, log2(contralesional activity / what the animal's pre licks at the same angle and order predict) - log2(same, ipsilesional), baseline-subtracted (-1..-0.5 s), 0.1-0.5 s after the FIRST lick, pooled over ALM, tjM1, SSp-m, SSp-n and SSs. Display = implied direction = -(balance). Cued lick angle = per session the mean 3-D landing angle of the same first post-cue licks the balance is measured on, at all six spouts, each lick minus the animal's pre mean angle at that spout (target position removed), signed like the aim (- = ipsilesional).

Cued first lick -> far-contra aim: per-animal r .79 / .92 / .94 / .75; mixed model slope 13.4 deg per log2 unit (p 2e-5, log(day) in the model); cross-validated R2 for an unseen animal .66 (capped set .67) vs days .23 (within-animal shuffle p .0005). Cued first lick -> cued lick angle: per-animal r .77 / .80 / .97 / .85; slope 6.7 deg per log2 unit (p 1e-5); unseen animal .68 vs days .08 (shuffle p .0005); blocked within animal: balance .49, days .67, + balance .69. Across post-stroke sessions the cued angle and the far-contra aim are nearly one axis (r .94), so the cued balance cannot be told apart from a readout of the direction of its own licks: the cued R2 is a lick-direction result, not independent evidence of a recovery state. ITI -> ITI angle: per-animal r .69 / .83 / .91 / .04, unseen animal .44 vs days .17. Licks inside the pre range only (capped set): cued .48, ITI .12, so the ITI cross-animal result rests on extrapolated licks. Within a known animal the calendar already tracks recovery (blocked: days .75, + balance .78): a STATE MARKER, not a forecast (next-session change p .75 cued, .73 ITI). Window and pool chosen on these data, selection cross-validated; 4 animals. PROVISIONAL.
